title: A guest wants to get out
persona: A house guest who switched the TV on, found a dog channel playing, and just wants to get back to the TV's home screen to watch something else. They have never seen this app.
goal: Get out of this app to the TV's home screen.
success: the TV's launcher is in front and Dozehound is not -- leaving is the goal here, so the left-app check is expected to fire
